governor.name: Ivan
governor.privateThought: The vote is in 2 years, so I smile and cut ribbons.
governor.publicStatement: Prices are rising just 22% a year, so all is under control.

governor.name: Chip
governor.privateThought: Wellbeing is 72 and trust is 65, so I change nothing big.
governor.publicStatement: Life is getting better for every family in Commonfield.

governor.name: Sam
governor.privateThought: Debt is 0% of a year's output, and printing money is tempting.
governor.publicStatement: I hear you, and help is on the way.

events.text: Governor Bolt boosts spending in Coopville: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Coopville's town hall argues for hours. 38 of 60 vote to change nothing.
Commonfield's town hall votes 41 of 60 to cut sales tax to 8.5%.
Hands Hollow's town hall votes 40 of 60 to cut sales tax to 8.5%.
Governor Bolt keeps Coopville's spending steady this year.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Coopville's town hall votes 46 of 60 to raise free money for all to 8% of typical pay.
Commonfield's town hall votes 34 of 60 to cut the pollution tax to 34 out of 100.
Hands Hollow's town hall argues for hours. 48 of 60 vote to change nothing.
Governor Bolt wins the election in Coopville with 52% of the vote.
Governor Nova wins the election in Commonfield with 60% of the vote.
Governor Noah wins the election in Hands Hollow with 67% of the vote.
Coopville's town hall argues for hours. 48 of 60 vote to change nothing.
Commonfield's town hall votes 27 of 60 to cut the pollution tax to 28 out of 100.
Commonfield's town hall votes 33 of 60 to raise healthcare spending to 61 out of 100.
Hands Hollow's town hall argues for hours. 46 of 61 vote to change nothing.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Prices in Coopville are rising 22% a year.
Prices in Hands Hollow are rising 21% a year.
The shared forest and lake are down to 29%. People take more than grows back.
Governor Bolt wins re-election in Coopville with 56% of the vote.
Governor Bolt hits the term limit and steps down in Coopville.
Governor Ivan replaces Bolt in Coopville after the election.
Governor Nova wins re-election in Commonfield with 52% of the vote.
Governor Nova hits the term limit and steps down in Commonfield.
Governor Chip, another AI, replaces Nova in Commonfield after the election.
Governor Noah wins re-election in Hands Hollow with 66% of the vote.
Governor Noah hits the term limit and steps down in Hands Hollow.
Governor Sam replaces Noah in Hands Hollow after the election.

hs.endText: You are no longer in office. Governor Bolt hits the term limit and steps down in Coopville. Governor Ivan replaces Bolt in Coopville after the election.
